Overview of Busan Region (부산광역시)

Busan Region (부산광역시) is located in the Busan region of South Korea, with its prefectural capital at Busan. Key sights and travel highlights across the prefecture include Haeundae & Gwangalli Beaches, Gamcheon Culture Village, Haedong Yonggungsa Temple, Jagalchi Fish Market & BIFF Square.

RegionBusan
Capital cityBusan
Cities & municipalities44
Primary transport hubBusan Central Station (KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail)

How to get to Busan Region

KTX from Seoul in 2h 15m to Busan Station; Gimhae International Airport (PUS); Busan Metro Lines 1–4. Use our KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail Fare & Route Calculator and Rail Pass Value Helper to compare rail tickets and regional passes.

Signature local food in Busan

When visiting cities across Busan, look out for these regional specialties at station restaurants, markets, and local izakaya:

  • Dwaeji gukbap (pork soup)
  • Milmyeon (cold wheat noodles)
  • Jagalchi raw seafood (hoe)
  • Ssiat hotteok
  • Eomuk (Busan fish cake)

Best time to visit Busan

Best time to visit Busan: Apr–Jun, Sep–Nov.
